item.tib: ma rgyud mkha' 'gro dgongs 'dus las bdag gzhan dam tshig 'brel pa gang srung ba rdo rje'i go khrab
item.coloph: ces srung ba rdo rje go khrab 'di ni/ snyigs dus rnal 'byor kun grol grags pas shar rong rnam dag bkod pa'i zhing khams kyi byang phyogs/ ngo mtshar nor bu'i gling du me 'brug zla tshes la/ khro chen rgyal po'i zhabs bstis mdzad cing / rigs mthun mkha' 'gro'i nyams rtogs spar bzhin du brtsams pa/ 'chi med rgyal ba'i bstan pa dang sems can gyi don rgya chen po 'grub par gyur cig
